## About Elysium λ

Elysium λ Development & Research is an independent digital consultancy and research organisation based in Portugal, European Union. It provides enterprise-grade digital infrastructure for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across Europe and Latin America (Portugal, Spain, Costa Rica, and the wider Ibero-American region).

The organisation operates at the intersection of web engineering, applied research, and human-centred design. Its mission is to investigate and develop digital systems focused on human development and the empowerment of SMEs through research and technological innovation.

**Vision:** To evolve into the λ Elysium Institute of Development & Research — an institute dedicated to the study, development, and application of intelligent systems, and the training of new generations of scientists and developers. The organisation actively aims to contribute to the construction of a digital Europe, where artificial intelligence, data science, and intelligent systems drive the development of organisations and communities.

**Core values:** Transparency, accessibility, ethical technology, and human-centred digital infrastructure.

---

## Services

Elysium λ offers subscription-based digital infrastructure. Clients pay no upfront development cost; all engineering is included in the monthly subscription.

### Subscription Tiers

**Hosting Maintenance — €99/year**
The Operational Core.
- Domain management and brand digital identity.
- Web hosting on high-availability servers (always online).
- Base infrastructure maintenance and updates.

**Basic Maintenance — €70/month**
Level 1 Ecosystem. Includes Hosting Maintenance plus:
- Complete development of your corporate website.
- Fluid design adapted for mobile devices.
- Ultra-fast loading times to prevent customer drop-off.
- Inclusive and accessible structure (WCAG compliance).
- Contact forms shielded against spam.
- Advanced security protocols.
- Full GDPR compliance.

**Preferential Maintenance — €99/month**
Level 2 Ecosystem. Includes all Basic features plus:
- Architecture prepared for future e-commerce and sales integrations.
- Perfectly structured multi-language website for global expansion.
- Smart visual design (automatic adaptation to light/dark modes).
- Real-time currency conversion engine for international clients.

**Advanced Maintenance — €120/month**
Level 3 Ecosystem. Includes all Preferential features plus:
- Private platform to manage clients and operations (CRM).
- User system with restricted permissions and access levels.
- Custom-built software that scales with business growth.
- Cloud databases protected by the highest industry standards.

**Custom Core CRM — €50/month (add-on)**
Independent management module:
- Intuitive, elegant control panel.
- 100% confidential workspace separated from the public site.
- Direct and centralised access from the secure Elysium client portal.

### Licensing & IP Policy
- Zero Development Cost: Elysium assumes 100% of initial engineering.
- Code remains intellectual property of Elysium λ Development & Research.
- Clients acquire a full-use licence tied to their active subscription.
- Buyout option available through an auditing and valuation process.

## About the Organisation (Nosotros / Sobre Nós)

**Mission:** Investigating and developing digital systems focused on human development and boosting SMEs through research and technological innovation. Elysium λ explores how intelligent systems can strengthen the digital capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises.

**Vision:** To evolve into the λ Elysium Institute of Development & Research, actively contributing to the construction of a digital Europe aligned with the highest standards of education, ethical technology, and the fundamental values of the European Union.
